---
title: "GSE26787"
output: html_notebook
---

Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(Biobase)
library(limma)
library(affy)
library(affyio)
library(R.utils)
library(dplyr)
library(sva)
library(plotly)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

```

Download the data
```{r}
gse<-getGEO('GSE26787')
gse<-gse[[1]]
phenotype_data<-pData(gse)
geo_accession<- "GSE26787"

```

Refine the phenotype data
```{r}
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>% rename(condition = source_name_ch1)

phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    grepl("fertile", condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
    grepl("failure", condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RIF",
    TRUE ~ condition #(Keep original value if neither is matched)
  ))
#remove the rows of patients with spontaneous abortion (not part of the current study and raw files alr deleted)
rows_to_remove <- c("GSM659113", "GSM659114", "GSM659115", "GSM659116", "GSM659117")
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data[!rownames(phenotype_data) %in% rows_to_remove, ]

```

Read the raw data
```{r}
output_dir<-"<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE26787/cel_files"
cel_files <- list.files(output_dir, pattern = "\\.CEL$", full.names = TRUE)
cel_data <-ReadAffy(filenames=cel_files)

#classify the pre-corrected data
prenorm_exprs<-exprs(cel_data)

```

Background correction and normalization w/ RMA
```{r}
corrected_data<-rma(cel_data)

#create a data frame for corrected data to use for annotation
exprs_df<-as.data.frame.ExpressionSet(corrected_data)
exprs_df<-t(exprs_df)
```

Validation
```{r}
boxplot(prenorm_exprs, main = "Before RMA")
boxplot(exprs_df, main = "After RMA")
```

Prep for annotation
```{r}
gpl<-getGEO("GPL570", AnnotGPL = TRUE)
gpl_annot <- Table(gpl)

# Extract the relevant mapping for GPL570
annotation_map <- gpl_annot[, c("ID", "Gene symbol")]
colnames(annotation_map) <- c("ProbeName", "GeneSymbol")
```

Annotation
```{r}
exprs <-as.data.frame(exprs_df)
#remove probe IDs from row names and make its own column
exprs <- rownames_to_column(exprs, var = "ProbeName")
exprs$ProbeName <- sub("^X", "", exprs$ProbeName)
#merge
annotated_exprs <- merge(exprs, annotation_map, by = "ProbeName", all.x = TRUE)
```

Clean up annotated data
```{r}
# 1. Remove rows without any GeneSymbol information (e.g., NA or empty string)
annotated_exprs_clean <- annotated_exprs %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol) & GeneSymbol != "")

# 2. Group by GeneSymbol and average expression values for duplicate gene symbols.
annotated_exprs_avg <- annotated_exprs_clean %>%
  group_by(GeneSymbol) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = -c(ProbeName), 
                   .fns = mean, 
                   na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Make gene symbols row names
```{r}
annotated_exprs_avg <- as.data.frame(annotated_exprs_avg)
# Check that GeneSymbol column exists
if("GeneSymbol" %in% colnames(annotated_exprs_avg)) {
  rownames(annotated_exprs_avg) <- annotated_exprs_avg$GeneSymbol
  annotated_exprs_avg <- annotated_exprs_avg[, !(names(annotated_exprs_avg) %in% "GeneSymbol")]
} else {
  warning("The column 'GeneSymbol' does not exist in the data frame.")
}

```

3D PCA
```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(annotated_exprs_avg), scale. = TRUE)

# Create a data frame with the first three principal components and sample conditions.
pca_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca$x[, 3],
  condition = phenotype_data$condition
)

# Calculate the percentage of variance explained for the first three PCs
var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:3] * 100

fig <- plot_ly(
  data = pca_data,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~condition,
   colors = c("red", "blue"), 
  type = 'scatter3d',
  mode = 'markers',
  marker = list(size = 5)
) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 2), "%)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 2), "%)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(var_exp[3], 2), "%)"))
    )
  )

# Display the interactive plot
fig

```

DE Analysis
Step 1: create design matrix
```{r}
group<-factor(phenotype_data$condition, levels = c("Control","RIF"))
levels(group) <- make.names(levels(group))
#Design model matrix
design<-model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
rownames(design) <- colnames(annotated_exprs_avg)
colnames(design) <- c("Control", "RIF")
```
Step 2: fit linear model to the data
```{r}
fit <- lmFit(annotated_exprs_avg, design)
```
Step 3: define contrast matrix
```{r}
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Control_vs_RIF = Control - RIF,
  levels = design
)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
```
Step 4: apply eBayes moderation
```{r}
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
```
Step 5: find the top genes
```{r}
top_genes <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Control_vs_RIF", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
#apply filter
de_genes <- top_genes[top_genes$P.Value < 0.05 & abs(top_genes$logFC) > 1, ]
```

heat map
```{r}
# Subset merged_data for the DE genes
de_gene_ids <- rownames(de_genes)
heatmap_data <- annotated_exprs_avg[de_gene_ids, ]

#Scale each row (gene) to mean=0 and sd=1 to emphasize relative differences
scaled_heatmap_data <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

# Create a column annotation data frame using the sample condition information
annotation_col <- data.frame(Condition = phenotype_data$condition)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(annotated_exprs_avg)

# Create the heatmap
pheatmap(scaled_heatmap_data,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Heatmap of Differentially Expressed Genes")

```
